items.why: Volatility jumped as stocks slid on rising bond yields and oil prices. The 10 year yield hit its highest level since 2002 and Brent neared $102 after tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz.
Bitcoin slipped under $84,000 as higher oil, yields and a stronger dollar pressured risk assets. About $550 million in leveraged crypto longs were liquidated in 24 hours, amplifying the move.
Dropped with the broader tech complex as rising yields pushed the market lower. No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
An EU vote on Full Self Driving approval was delayed to December, cooling hopes for more subscription revenue. The stock gave back part of its recent three day run.

market_note: Fed minutes from the September meeting arrive later today; traders have mostly priced out another October hike.
summary: Yields are the story again. The 10 year hit its highest level since 2002 and oil neared $102 on Strait of Hormuz tanker attacks, pushing stocks lower. The Dow fell about 500 points while Bitcoin dropped under $84,000.
